flare_rate_per_d.source: not available: no published flare rate per day was confirmed: the star is in neither the Guenther et al. 2020 TESS catalogue (AJ 159, 60; sectors 1-2) nor the Medina et al. 2020 sample (ApJ 905, 107)

lum_lsun.assumption: FLAME luminosity from the Gaia G magnitude, the GSP-Phot extinction, the parallax (or GSP-Phot distance) and a bolometric correction that depends on the GSP-Phot Teff, gravity and metallicity (Gaia DR3 datamodel, lum_flame); a model value, not a measured luminosity, and it inherits GSP-Phot's weakness for cool stars
lum_lsun.source: Gaia DR3 astrophysical_parameters lum_flame, source 4472832130942575872, matched 0.00 arcsec from the SIMBAD position moved to 2016.0 by its proper motion

mass_msun.source: not available: Gaia DR3 has no FLAME mass_flame for this star

pm_mas_yr.source: SIMBAD NAME Barnard's star (pmra = mu_alpha * cos(delta), pmdec)

radius_rsun.assumption: FLAME radius from the GSP-Phot Teff and a model bolometric luminosity (Gaia DR3 radius_flame); a model value, not a measured radius, and it inherits GSP-Phot's weakness for cool stars
radius_rsun.source: Gaia DR3 astrophysical_parameters radius_flame, source 4472832130942575872, matched 0.00 arcsec from the SIMBAD position moved to 2016.0 by its proper motion

rot_period_h.source: literature: Toledo-Padron et al. 2019, MNRAS 488, 5145 (arXiv:1812.06712), Abstract: 'the rotation period of the star is 145 +/- 15 days' (backend/assets/literature.toml). 145 +/- 15 d (x 24 h), from the periodograms of spectroscopic activity indicators

teff_K.formula: median of the non-null Teff values in SIMBAD mesFe_h; of two middle values, the one from the most recent bibcode (Q-152)
teff_K.source: SIMBAD mesFe_h: median of 55 published spectroscopic Teff values (3083 to 3530 K); the middle value is from 2022A&A...658A.194P

render_params.alt_text: NAME Barnard's star, Star, 0.202 solar radii (model dependent), colour from Teff, self-luminous. Surface relief: illustrative.

confidence.formula: C = sum(w_i c_i) / sum(w_i): c is 1 for a measured value or a formula of measured values, a placeholder share for a model-dependent one, and 0 for an assumed, artistic or missing one; the w_i are placeholder weights (D-36, Q-221)
confidence.found: Data for: Temperature and colour, radius, spectral class and rotation and magnetic field.
confidence.note: This is how much of the picture rests on data. It is not the probability that the picture is correct.
confidence.weights_note: Placeholder weights: they come from the approved prototype until a sensitivity sweep replaces them (D-36).

layers.description: Teff to sRGB through a blackbody colour calculation (R7.5).
layers.formula: Planck(Teff) integrated 380-780 nm against the CIE 1931 2-degree colour-matching functions (Wyman, Sloan & Shirley 2013 fit), XYZ -> linear sRGB (D65), clipped at 0, brightest channel = 1 (R7.5)

layers.description: Assumption: linear limb darkening, I(mu) = 1 - 0.6 * (1 - mu) (R7.5).
Motion trail from pm_mas_yr over the SPHEREx epochs (R7.5).

rgb.formula: Planck(Teff) integrated 380-780 nm against the CIE 1931 2-degree colour-matching functions (Wyman, Sloan & Shirley 2013 fit), XYZ -> linear sRGB (D65), clipped at 0, brightest channel = 1 (R7.5)
